heading.en: Birth, family and early army training

body.zh-Hant: 若昂·德·德烏斯·梅納·巴雷托1874年6月30日生於阿雷格里港，父親是將軍若澤·路易斯·梅納·巴雷托。家族自18世紀起多人從軍，約有15人官至將軍。他1890年1月進入里約帕爾多戰術射擊學校，1898年3月進入里約的巴西軍事學校，1900年9月升任中尉。
body.en: João de Deus Mena Barreto was born in Porto Alegre on 30 June 1874, the son of General José Luís Mena Barreto. Many members of his family had followed military careers since the 18th century, and about 15 reached the rank of general. He entered the Tactical and Shooting School of Rio Pardo in January 1890, joined the Military School of Brazil in Rio de Janeiro in March 1898, and was promoted to lieutenant in September 1900.

heading.zh-Hant: 從鎮壓叛亂到第一軍區司令
heading.en: From suppressing revolts to commanding the 1st Military Region

body.zh-Hant: 1910年11月他參與鎮壓里約蛇島海軍陸戰營的叛亂。1921年9月升任准將，1922年2月出任第二步兵旅指揮官。1924年7月聖保羅爆發新一輪尉官叛亂，他被任命為北方支隊總司令，前往馬瑙斯對付第27獵兵營的叛變。1924年10月他代理第一軍區司令，同年12月獲少將軍銜並正式任職，1926年3月請辭。
body.en: In November 1910 he took part in suppressing the revolt of the Naval Battalion on Cobras Island, Rio de Janeiro. He was promoted to brigadier general in September 1921 and became commander of the 2nd Infantry Brigade in February 1922. When a new lieutenants' revolt broke out in São Paulo in July 1924, he was named commander-in-chief of the Northern Detachment sent to Manaus against the mutiny of the 27th Chasseur Battalion. In October 1924 he acted as commander of the 1st Military Region, was confirmed in December after being made a general of division, and resigned the command in March 1926.

heading.en: The 1930 revolution and the provisional governing junta

body.zh-Hant: 1930年10月3日推翻總統華盛頓·路易斯的革命爆發後，首都的高階軍官在梅納·巴雷托的領導下策劃軍事政變。10月24日早晨他與塔索·弗拉戈索前往瓜納巴拉宮，要求總統辭職；總統不肯，隨即組成臨時軍政委員會，由塔索·弗拉戈索任主席，梅納·巴雷托與伊薩亞斯·德諾羅尼亞為成員。美國大使的電報同日記載委員會已成立並接管政府；11月3日瓦加斯接任臨時政府首腦。
body.en: After the revolution that toppled President Washington Luís broke out on 3 October 1930, senior officers in the capital began planning a military coup under Mena Barreto's leadership. On the morning of 24 October he and Tasso Fragoso went to Guanabara Palace to demand that the president resign; he refused, and a provisional governing junta was formed, presided over by Tasso Fragoso with Mena Barreto and Isaías de Noronha as members. The US ambassador's telegram of the same day recorded that the junta had been formed and had taken over the government; on 3 November Vargas assumed the leadership of the Provisional Government.

body.zh-Hant: 瓦加斯上台後，梅納·巴雷托仍任第一軍區群監察長；1931年5月起兼任里約熱內盧州聯邦干預官，因不同意8月公布的《干預官法典》，三個月後請辭，接著被任命為最高軍事法院法官。1932年聖保羅爆發憲政革命時，他保持中立，並在9月介入停火談判。他於1933年3月25日在最高軍事法院任內於里約熱內盧去世。
body.en: After Vargas took power, Mena Barreto was kept as inspector of the 1st Group of Military Regions; from May 1931 he also served as federal interventor in Rio de Janeiro, but he disagreed with the Code of Interventors published in August, resigned three months later, and was then appointed a minister of the Superior Military Tribunal. He stayed neutral during the Constitutionalist Revolution of São Paulo in 1932 and intervened in the September negotiations to end the hostilities. He died in Rio de Janeiro on 25 March 1933 while still serving on the tribunal.

body.zh-Hant: 古斯塔夫五世1858年6月16日生於德羅特寧霍爾姆宮，父母是國王奧斯卡二世與拿騷的索菲亞，同年6月19日受封為韋姆蘭公爵。1872年9月18日他成為瑞典與挪威的王儲，1881年9月20日在卡爾斯魯厄與巴登的維多利亞成婚。
body.en: Gustaf V was born at Drottningholm Palace on 16 June 1858, the son of King Oscar II and Sophia of Nassau, and was made Duke of Värmland on 19 June of that year. He became crown prince of Sweden and Norway on 18 September 1872 and married Victoria of Baden at Karlsruhe on 20 September 1881.

heading.en: Dissolution of the union and accession

body.zh-Hant: 1905年6月7日挪威議會宣布終止聯盟時，王儲古斯塔夫正在柏林訪問；他在春天的攝政期間已判斷局勢無望，並支持和平解散聯盟。1907年12月8日他繼位為瑞典國王，並決定放棄加冕。
body.en: When the Norwegian Storting broke the union on 7 June 1905, Crown Prince Gustaf was on a visit to Berlin; during his regency that spring he had already judged the situation hopeless, and he backed a peaceful dissolution. He became King of Sweden on 8 December 1907 and decided to forgo a coronation.

heading.en: The 1914 farmers' march and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 1914年2月他在農民遊行上發表演說，史塔夫政府隨後下台，這場「庭院危機」是他政治活動的頂點。大戰期間他努力支持並保住哈馬舍爾德內閣，認為它最能保證可靠的外交路線。1917年秋，他雖不情願，仍接受由艾登出任首相的新政權，等於承認了議會制。
body.en: In February 1914 his speech to the farmers' march was followed by the fall of Staaff's government; the "courtyard crisis" marked the peak of his political activity. During the war he worked to support and keep the Hammarskjöld ministry, which he thought best guaranteed a reliable foreign course. In autumn 1917, although reluctantly, he accepted the new regime under Prime Minister Edén, thereby recognising parliamentarism.

heading.en: The 1925 disarmament dispute and the Second World War

body.zh-Hant: 1925年面對裁軍決議，他反應激烈，一度考慮拒絕批准。1939年10月他倡議在斯德哥爾摩召開國家元首會議，以支持受威脅的芬蘭。1943年85歲生日的「庭院演說」中，他說明自己在世界大戰的非常時期出面協助國家度過難關。1945年夏他說：先是挪威、再是兩次世界大戰，實在太多。
body.en: Faced with the 1925 disarmament decision he reacted fiercely and considered refusing sanction. In October 1939 he took the initiative for a meeting of heads of state in Stockholm to support threatened Finland. In his "courtyard speech" on his 85th birthday in 1943 he explained that during the great world crisis he had seen it as his duty to help the country through its difficulties. In summer 1945 he remarked that first Norway and then two world wars was too much.

body.zh-Hant: 威廉明娜1880年8月31日生於海牙，是威廉三世之女。1890年11月23日父王去世，她成為荷蘭女王，但在滿十八歲前由母后艾瑪攝政。1898年9月6日舉行加冕（就職）典禮，開始親自執政。
body.en: Wilhelmina was born in The Hague on 31 August 1880, the daughter of William III. Her father died on 23 November 1890 and she became Queen of the Netherlands, but until her eighteenth year she reigned under the regency of her mother, Queen Emma. Her inauguration took place on 6 September 1898, after which she ruled in her own right.

heading.zh-Hant: 內閣組成與第一次世界大戰
heading.en: Cabinet formation and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 1908年2月11日與12日，她主持海姆斯克爾克內閣大臣宣誓；1913年8月29日又主持科爾特·范德林登內閣宣誓。大戰期間荷蘭中立屢受威脅，1918年5月她拒絕解除總司令斯奈德斯的職務，內閣於6月8日讓步。同年9月9日，她主持首屆呂伊斯·德貝倫布魯克內閣宣誓。
body.en: On 11 and 12 February 1908 she swore in the ministers of the Heemskerk cabinet, and on 29 August 1913 those of the Cort van der Linden cabinet. During the war, as Dutch neutrality was repeatedly threatened, she refused in May 1918 to dismiss the commander-in-chief C.J. Snijders, and the cabinet gave way on 8 June. On 9 September 1918 she swore in the ministers of the first Ruijs de Beerenbrouck cabinet.

heading.en: The 1939 cabinet change and the German invasion

body.zh-Hant: 1939年7月27日科林的事務內閣在數日內被推翻，她只得接受沒有科林的德格爾內閣（1939–1940）。1940年5月德軍入侵荷蘭，她於5月13日搭英國驅逐艦「赫里沃德號」離開荷蘭，當晚在英國登陸。
body.en: On 27 July 1939 the Colijn business cabinet was brought down within days, and she had to accept a government without Colijn, the De Geer cabinet (1939–1940). When the German forces overran the Netherlands in May 1940, she left the country on 13 May aboard the British destroyer HMS Hereward and came ashore in Britain that evening.

body.zh-Hant: 流亡英國期間，她從1940年7月28日起經「橙色電台」向國民廣播並呼籲抵抗。1940年9月4日首相德格爾下台，由強勢的格爾布蘭迪接任；她也阻止了政府遷往巴達維亞。1942年8月她向美國國會演說，同年12月7日在廣播中宣布調整與荷屬東印度的關係。1945年3月13日她在埃德重新踏上荷蘭土地，5月5日發表解放廣播。
body.en: In exile in Britain she broadcast regularly on Radio Oranje from 28 July 1940, urging resistance. Prime Minister De Geer fell on 4 September 1940 and was replaced by the forceful P.S. Gerbrandy; she also prevented the seat of government from moving to Batavia. She addressed the US Congress in August 1942 and announced on 7 December 1942 a reform of relations with the Netherlands Indies. She set foot on Dutch soil again at Eede on 13 March 1945 and gave a radio speech on the liberation on 5 May 1945.

body.zh-Hant: 1945年5月29日她任命斯海默霍恩與德里斯為組閣人，6月27日主持斯海默霍恩—德里斯內閣宣誓。同年11月她反對解除副總督範穆克的職務。她作為荷蘭女王的任期一直持續到1948年9月4日。
body.en: On 29 May 1945 she named Schermerhorn and Drees as formateurs and on 27 June swore in the Schermerhorn–Drees cabinet. In November 1945 she opposed the dismissal of Lieutenant Governor-General Van Mook. Her reign as queen ran until 4 September 1948.
